section: SM6. Tie scores, random baselines and uncertainty
caption: **Implementation interface.** `application/README.md` specifies the runnable cell-level interface, normalization, identifier mapping, control inputs and output tables. `application/run_h5ad.py` accepts AnnData counts through `fit_anndata()`, supporting dense or CSR matrices in memory or backed storage. Full-axis library totals precede gene selection; control and target-cell moments are estimated from the supplied cells. The interface takes a supplied query list and requires no deep reference for nomination. `METHOD_INTERFACE.md` describes the input and sufficient-statistic contracts, including target-directional variance. Dense/sparse/backed and frozen-engine parity checks test implementation consistency. Historical saved-moment replays for D3 and Orion remain separate in the analysis archives (SN9); they reproduce weights and lists but do not reconstruct raw-cell preprocessing.

section: SN2.3. Unchanged implementations on D2
caption: **What is shown and what is not.** That the rule reorders targets only through their noise differences is an identity; that this reordering lowered precision on both donors is the observation. Whether it does so because true hits with large effects also have a large cell-to-cell spread and are moved down has not been tested: an unstable 20-cell variance, an ill-fitting zero-centred prior and the truncation of `tau^2` at zero could each contribute. On D2 the rule was run unchanged (SN5.2).
